Contract ManageSupplierCRUDService::modifySupplier(id: Integer,name: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		id: Integer,
		name: String
	precondition:
		let obs: Supplier = Supplier.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id) in
		obs.isEmpty() = false
	postcondition:
		let ob: Supplier = Supplier.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id) in
		ob.Name = name and
		result = true
}
